The local connection

Big on relationships.
Close to home.

A familiar name in Jaipur's everyday trade, Bansal Sales Corporation brings consumer brands and local retailers together.

From our base in Purani Basti, we receive stock, prepare orders and deliver goods to neighbourhood shops. Behind each carton is a team that knows the work—and the city.

Started by Prakash Bansal and carried forward with his son Yash, Bansal Sales Corporation is rooted in the everyday business of Jaipur.

Ours is a story of knowing the products, understanding the shopkeeper and staying connected to the people who make local trade possible.
